artworks.title: The Head of Christ
artworks.medium: black, red, and white chalks on gray-green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed pencil sketch of a person's head in profile, extending up to the neck and shoulders. The person is depicted in a thoughtful or contemplative position with their head gently bowed forward. The facial features reveal a concentrated expression, with a prominent nose and a slight shadow under the eyes, which are partially closed. The hair is shoulder-length and appears to be wavy. There is no visible clothing detailed in the sketch, and no jewelry or objects are apparent. The background of the image is simple, unadorned paper providing a neutral, textured backdrop that enhances the focus on the sketched figure.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: oil on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various figures, animals, and celestial beings. In the foreground, there are animals and people in dynamic poses. The central figure holds an infant. Above them, celestial figures are depicted in flowing garments. Architectural elements are visible in the background. The artwork uses a limited color palette of sepia tones and blue washes.

artworks.title: Christ Led Captive from a Palace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brown and gray wash (for architecture), pen and black ink (foreground), pen and gray ink (background), both with brown wash (for the figures)
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with arches and columns. The scene includes figures engaged in various actions with intricate architectural details such as large arches and tall columns adorned with ornate capitals. The structure appears to be part of a staircase and the figures are depicted in draped clothing, some holding staffs or banners, including a figure holding a large cross. The scene is in a monochromatic palette with a sepia tone, reminiscent of sketches from the Renaissance period. The drawing highlights the artist's skill in perspective, depth, and the opulence of the architecture.

artworks.title: The Raising of Tabitha
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a central focal point. The drawing depicts several figures interacting, all centered around a sitting figure in a robe. The setting appears to be an architectural space with tall stone walls and an arched doorway in the background. The figures are dressed in ancient-style clothing, and their gestures give a sense of urgency or emotion to the scene. The drawing is done in a monochrome, sepia-toned style, highlighting light and shadow.

artworks.title: Punchinellos Hunting Waterfowl
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in white outfits with pointed hats shooting at birds over a body of water. The horizon is at the top of the image, with land extending to the left where a small structure is visible. The scene shows careful brushstrokes detailing the water and land textures. Earthy sepia tones dominate the color palette. Birds can be seen in the water, with two taking flight as a dog approaches from the shore. A fir tree on the far right frames the scene's action.

artworks.title: An Aedicule with Two Studies of Saint Christopher
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking barefoot while carrying a child on his shoulders. The man is holding a staff in his left hand, stepping forward. He has wavy hair, defined facial features, and wears loose-fitting clothing. The child has curly hair and a halo, reaching towards the man's head. In the background, there is a partially visible architectural structure. The image is in monochrome with signs of aging on the paper.

artworks.title: A Sibyl
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's upper body in a three-quarter view. She is slightly angled to her right, with closed eyes, a prominent nose, and a slightly downturned mouth. Her long, wavy hair cascades down her shoulders from beneath an intricately detailed headdress. She wears a fitted bodice with ties down the front and a cloak over her shoulders. Her hands are crossed at the wrist in front of her. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Maximilian, Duke of Austria, on Horseback
artworks.artist: Primary Master of the Strassburg Chronicle
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper ruled in leadpoint
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a figure riding a horse. The person is in a seated position atop the horse, which is rearing up on its hind legs. The rider has long, curly hair that flows outward from their head. They wear armor and a plumed helmet. In their hand, they hold a sword poised upwards. Surrounding the rider are heraldic shields featuring different coat of arms. The background is filled with decorative heraldry, text, and emblematic designs. The horse's harness is elaborately decorated.

artworks.title: Head of a Boy
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with touches of graphite, heightened with white on blue prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image is a close-up of a person's head and upper shoulders. The person's face is shown in a three-quarter view, slightly turned to the side. Their facial features include softly rounded cheeks, a small nose, and a gentle expression. The person has curly hair that frames the face, with the curls intricately detailed. They are wearing a garment with a visible collar or fold near the shoulder. The image is rendered in monochrome with a textured teal background. There is a signature or marking at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man in a Broad-Brimmed Hat
artworks.artist: Swiss 16th Century after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.medium: black chalk and wetted red chalk with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person in a seated position facing forward, with their head turned slightly to the left. The individual has fair skin and is depicted with a full face, including distinct lips and a prominent nose; their eyes gaze slightly to the left. Their hair, which is dark and curly, is partially visible under a large, dark hat with a wide brim. The person is wearing a garment with a high collar, and the fabric appears to be softly draped around the shoulders. The background is neutral, with a textured paper surface that adds to the classic nature of the drawing. There is an artist's signature visible at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Four Latin Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image is a detailed sketch of four full-length figures seated in a formal setting. Each person is holding a long staff and dressed in elaborate robes with intricate patterns and layered garments. The figures have fine facial features without specific descriptions of expressions. They wear ornate headgear that includes veils and crowns resembling miters. Simple architectural elements like pillars and columns frame the gathering. In the background, there is a small tower or castle visible through an opening, adding depth to the scene. The sketch likely depicts a historical or religious context.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: tempera heightened with gold on vellum mounted to wood
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: This is a painting of a traditional nativity scene. The scene shows figures, animals, and an outdoor setting with rustic architecture. The main focus is on a group of people gathered around a central figure holding a child. There are decorative elements such as animals, ornately dressed individuals, and angelic figures hovering above. The colors are rich and finely detailed, with a balance between delicate and vivid tones.

artworks.title: The Bagpipe Player
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, with some incised lines, on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: Drawn with delicate lines in brown ink on vertically oriented, dark tan-colored paper, a man playing a bagpipe sits in a stool, which he tips to one side. The man has a round face with oversized, puffed cheeks. His eyes are squinted shut, and his features are pressed into the middle of his face. He has wispy, chin-length hair and wears a shallow, floppy cap. He blows hard into the mouthpiece of the bagpipe, which he holds between both arms as he fingers the recorder-like chanter. The man wears a baggy-sleeved jacket over tight-fitting pants and slippers. His knees are splayed wide, and a prominent codpiece is framed by the jacket’s quarters, the short front flaps. The three-legged stool has a triangular seat. The man tips the stool up on two legs, angled to our left. The paper is darkened in some areas and chipped around the edges. The artist signed the drawing near the lower left corner, “P. Bréugel f.”

artworks.title: Acis and Galatea
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and traces of white heightening over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows two figures reclining closely together. The bodies are detailed, showing skin texture and muscle definition from the waist up. One figure has obscured facial features, while the other has visible delicate features and curly hair. The clothing appears minimal, resembling flowing drapery. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background consists of abstract shapes and lines, suggesting a natural environment.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with Castles and Waterfalls
artworks.medium: black, ocher, red, and blue chalks, with traces of white heightening on gray-green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image depicts a rugged landscape with towering rock formations and a cascading waterfall. The scene is detailed with precise lines and subtle color washes in earthy tones. Small structures are visible in the distance among the rocky terrain, with sparse vegetation in the background.

artworks.title: Winter Games on the Frozen River Ijssel
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with watercolor, gouache, and graphite on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This painting depicts a busy scene on a frozen river or lake, filled with a crowd of people. The horizon is in the center, showing boats and low buildings in the distance. Closer to us, many people are engaged in different activities on the ice. Some ride in a horse-drawn sled, while others play a game with long sticks and small round balls. The people wear colorful clothing in shades of red, blue, yellow, green, and black. Some of the women wear elaborate gowns with ruffled collars, while the men wear colorful suits and wide-brimmed hats. Other people wear simpler jackets and trousers. A few dogs run on the ice among the crowds. Aside from the colorful clothing, the color palette is mostly shades of cream, light gray, and pale blue.

artworks.title: Interior of Saint Bavo's Church, Haarlem
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and touches of red chalk over graphite on laid paper, squared in red chalk; laid down
artworks.creditLine: The Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner

artworks.title: The Parable of the Publican and the Pharisee
artworks.medium: reed pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner

artworks.title: Culemborg Castle
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a large circular castle-like building on the right side, with a low horizon on the center-right meeting a reflective water surface. The brushstrokes are subtle and delicate, emphasizing details and smooth transitions between shades. The color palette consists of gray and sepia tones. The water reflects the structures, creating depth. In the distance to the left, additional buildings with pointed roofs and smaller towers are visible.

artworks.title: Seven Famous Figures from Ancient History
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor, heightened with white, on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noblewoman (Madame de Pellegars?)
artworks.medium: black and red chalks with stumping, heightened with white chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows an unfinished portrait of a person's face and upper torso. The person is facing the viewer with their head slightly turned to the left. They have fair skin, light-colored eyes, eyebrows, and narrow lips. Their hair is styled back, and they are wearing a large ruff around their neck. The clothing details around the ruff are suggested in light pencil. The person is wearing a pearl earring in their right ear. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Cupid Stealing Venus's Floral Crown
artworks.medium: orange-red, white, and black chalk, squared for transfer in black chalk, on blue laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person in a relaxed seated pose with their back slightly inclined and head tilted to the right. The person has closed eyes, a serene expression, and styled hair in an updo. They are draped in cloth, with a smaller figure depicted to the upper right holding a wreath or garland over the main figure's head. The background is a neutral tone.

artworks.title: A Performance by the Commedia dell'Arte
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting. The scene depicts several animated figures against classical architectural elements such as columns and arches. The figures are rendered in a loose, expressive line, capturing motion and emotion in their gestures. The drawing has a sketched quality and employs ink with varying thickness and washes to suggest depth and texture. The emphasis on movement and interaction, combined with the architectural setting, suggests a lively and dynamic moment frozen in time.

artworks.title: Studies of Ornament and Architecture
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image displays a series of intricate, swirling lines and shapes that form an abstract composition. The arrangement of the lines and curves resemble ornate architectural details or decorative elements. The drawing invites the viewer to connect these forms to familiar objects like decorative scrollwork or vintage calligraphy. The overall appearance of the piece is reminiscent of a detailed sketch focused on exploring patterns and textures.
